meta.strategicSummary: Day 30 of the Hormuz closure sees a decisive de-escalatory signal from the U.S. side: Trump's announced military wind-down paired with a national address, simultaneously met by Iran's president offering a 'no enmity' olive branch. This bilateral rhetorical retreat substantially deflates U.S. coercive credibility (c drops to 0.72) and weakens the security guarantee (Ps to 7), while Iran retains full sanctions pressure since no formal OFAC/SWIFT relief has been announced. The pattern strongly suggests a back-channel deal is in late stages, but the yuan infrastructure gains (G=8, H=8) remain locked in regardless of resolution, and Sr=0.78 holds until formal diplomatic instruments are signed. Brent at $100.24 reflects markets beginning to price in de-escalation without full closure relief — consistent with uncertainty about whether the wind-down translates to actual Hormuz reopening or merely reduced kinetic operations.
meta.mostSignificantEvent: Headline 0 — Trump's military wind-down announcement is the most significant event because it unilaterally collapses U.S. coercive credibility on day 30, effectively confirming to Iran and global markets that the maximum pressure phase is ending without a formal settlement, handing Iran a strategic endurance victory regardless of subsequent negotiations.

paramNotes.dual_strait: Binary flag: 0 = Hormuz-only scenario; 1 = dual-strait activation (Hormuz + Bab-el-Mandeb via Houthi proxy). When 1, m switches from m_base to m_activated.
paramNotes.m_base: Geographic multiplier when only Hormuz is threatened (~20% global oil). Default 3.0.
paramNotes.m_activated: Geographic multiplier when both Hormuz and Bab-el-Mandeb (Houthi proxy) are simultaneously threatened (~30% global oil + Red Sea disruption). Default 4.75.
paramNotes.mediator_status: Binary flag: 1 = Qatar/Oman back-channel operative (sanctions-relief pathway open); 0 = mediator pathway closed (IRGC strike on Qatari/Omani assets or diplomatic rupture). When 0, Sr is gated — cannot rise regardless of diplomatic signals.
